messages:
harper: Starting thread for Aurora onboarding — main goals: marketplace SKU mapping, SI redistribution policy, EdgeBox bundle constraints, and embargo timing. Need a short plan and owners.

ben: Quick note: provider sent two license variants. One permissive (Apache-like) and one commercial addendum request for redistribution. They prefer permissive publicly but want control over SI redistribution.

anya: Product preference is to show hosted + dedicated SKUs publicly and mark an SI-bundle as "contact sales" / gated. That avoids accidentally enabling rehosting without paperwork.

legal-bot: uploaded: /legal/aurora/base_license.txt and /legal/aurora/si_redistrib_template_v0.docx (sha1: 9f8a7c). Key rec: permissive base license means we cannot add use restrictions via the same file; must use a separate signed addendum for SI redistribution or preinstall rights.

harper: For EdgeBox preinstall, we need explicit vendor consent. If EdgeBox images include weights, we must confirm their distro terms and whether images can cross borders (EU export stuff). Mike, can infra confirm technical and compliance constraints?

mike: Ops POV: if SIs rehost, we lose telemetry and SLO control. Options: (1) only allow distribution of quantized artifacts under addendum + validated runtime checks, (2) allow rehosting but require periodic attestation + audit right, (3) disallow rehosting and push SIs to use Redwood-hosted or Dedicated. Each has tradeoffs.

ben: Provider prefers option 2 if audits are tight. They said escrow for FP32 is acceptable but prefer not to release raw weights broadly. They did explicitly allow INT8 quantized distribution under addendum.

anya: Marketplace copy idea: "Aurora — 13B community model tuned for inference. Available on Redwood Hosted & Dedicated. SI integration and hardware bundles available under enterprise redistribution agreements." Keep it short; include attribution + model card link.

harper: Good. Add embargo clause: provider requests no public announcement until 10 business days after the marketplace listing goes live. Will that work with marketing?

ben: Legal action items: 1) finish an addendum that covers SI redistribution, preinstall rights, attestation checklist, right-to-audit, and revocation upon breach. 2) add a geo-restriction clause for EU-only SKUs. ETA Wed EOD.

mike: Technical action items: 1) draft validated-runtime checklist (kernel versions, quant steps, KV cache consistency, sample prompt regression tests), 2) automation for onboarding tests, 3) guidance for EdgeBox image licensing (if preinstall allowed). ETA Thu.

anya: Product action items: SKU taxonomy (hosted/dedicated/private + SI-gated bundle), marketplace tags (open-model, si-gated, geo-restricted), and pricing placeholders for SI redistribution. Will share matrix tomorrow.

legal-bot: Placed draft addendum in drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/aurora/si_addendum_draft_v0.2.docx. Note: include clear language that addendum governs redistribution rights separate from base license.

harper: Marketing check: if embargo is 10 business days, we should lock PR assets and partner comms now. Mario/marketing: can you confirm sync? (not in thread)

mike: One more infra note: if EdgeBox demands preinstalled weights, we must ensure image signatures and tamper-proof packaging. Also decide whether preinstall counts as redistribution (likely yes).

ben: Suggest two-track commercial approach in negotiations: public permissive listing for hosted & dedicated; commercial addendum for SI rehosting and EdgeBox preinstalls. That matches provider comfort and protects Redwood.

anya: Agree. We'll gate SI bundle behind sales and legal sign-off. Also we'll surface embargo metadata on the marketplace entry.

harper: Recap and owners: legal (ben) addendum; infra (mike) validated runtime + image constraints; product (anya) SKU & listing copy; marketing to coordinate embargo. Sync Fri 9:30am PT to finalize.

ben: I'll start outreach to provider legal with the two-track proposal and share redline in drive.

anya: Thanks team. Posting owners in Aurora drive and will create the invite for Fri. :white_check_mark:
